I don’t get the love for this software .  I bought the business tier for a 2
Person shop.  The sign up is unintuitive and clunky.  1/4 through the automated set up it essentially stopped…leaving a screen with zero prompts…as if I was done, when in fact it wasn’t.  So I spent 8 hours chasing
Down solutions for how to connect to my domain register.  And even with that all finished...  The email will not be accepted by outlook running clients in the US (which is basically everybody.  ). They don’t get anything I send them, as MS evidently consider proton accounts evil.  

For a startup needing quick, easy to implement solutions, this has been a disaster.  Avoid it if you value your mental health.

The app is solid... for now.... the company isn't though

So, for context, the CEO recently started bullying employees for not using AI to write all the code, the CFO wrote an AI manifesto. The CEO also tried to do a "reinterview" process, in hopes to fire every employee that didn't use AI.

For a privacy and security based service, using AI to do all the coding to rush a product isn't good. LLMs by design make code as generic as possible.. which is much easier to attack.

Unless some miracle U-turn happens... the future for Proton isn't looking very bright, please take your business elsewhere, or at the very least, until the CEO gets his head out of the AI bong cloud

reviews.text:
Seems like an obvious security floor for a company prided in security and privacy.

Any email or managed email address can be used to log into the master account for all other emails.

Essentially meaning every email you hand out unless it’s an alias can be used to log into your account.

Even Microsoft allow this to be restricted so that your log in email is a completely private email that’s never been released.
If you want to constantly have problems logging in and miss some messages, this app is perfect for you.

reviews.title: Going downhill, super unstable and freezes
reviews.text:
So sad to write this review but as a long time user of the app, in recent months I have experienced a huge drop in quality. For the last few months, emails I read on my phone do not get marked as “read” (even if I manually mark it as read, it gets unmarked!) - only on desktop web can I get my emails to be marked as read. OK, fine, I thought I could deal with this.

But recently, the app has started to completely freeze when I am in the middle of reading an email. I have to quit the app, wait a few seconds, and restart to keep reading. This is so disruptive and it’s been happening for weeks. As a supporter of privacy rights I hate to be writing this but I just can’t believe the core user experience of *reading emails* is now freezing the app. Why was everything working great for years and now this? It’s so disappointing. I can no longer recommend this app.

reviews.text: Bold, italic, underline. That’s it. Want a bulleted list in your email? Sorry not supported. Come on guys, some basic formatting should be a given in an email composer these days. It’s supported in the webmail interface, why not the app? Laziness?
